text: {"assertions":["A flaky CI job in build/ci/pipeline.yml was fixed on 2026-03-05 by addressing an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The flaky job only manifested with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels deep.","The root cause was an N+1 query that could be reproduced by rerunning the same commit ten times.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query via PR #5538 on branch fix/flaky-job-1.","Cold start performance improved by 57% after the fix, dropping to 91 milliseconds.","The flaky job presented as a single job failing on only a minority of runs."]}
